name: Whirr the Blue-Grey Cat
blurb: Whirr, a smoky blue-grey shorthair with bright green eyes, purrs a steady low hum and keeps one eye open over the garden all night long.

name: Cache the Silver Tabby Cat
blurb: Cache, a silver tabby with neat straight black stripes and copper eyes, remembers every spot in the garden where a treat was tucked away.

name: Porchlight the White Cat
blurb: Porchlight, a bright white longhair with pale gold eyes, sits under the garden lamp each evening, so white she seems to glow on her own.
